artworks.title: Woman Walking to the Right
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash and white heightening on light brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length sketch of a person in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. The person seems to be leaning forward slightly, with their right arm extended outward and their left hand resting on their waist. Their face is in profile, with subtle facial features, and their hair seems to be tucked back or covered. The person is wearing long, flowing robes with detailed folds and drapery. The background consists of a textured surface, likely from aged paper, with no distinct objects or scenery visible.

artworks.title: Lady in Formal Dress
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, looking at the viewer. She has fair skin, styled hair with a white accessory, and is wearing an ornate dress with floral patterns. She holds a bouquet and stands in front of a stone wall with a tall pedestal holding a blue vase. The background features a painted interior or garden setting with soft colors.

artworks.title: Nude with Putto
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening over black chalk, laid down
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures, one standing and one bending forward as if assisting the other. The larger figure has long hair and indistinct facial features, wearing flowing clothing. The background is abstract with flowing lines and shades of gray. The figures are within a decorative frame with a light green tint.

artworks.title: The Trinity and the Virgin Appearing to Ecclesiastics
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink over black chalk
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 28.7 x 41.5 cm (11 5/16 x 16 5/16 in.)
support: 40 x 53.7 cm (15 3/4 x 21 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central seated figure with celestial elements. The scene is densely packed with various figures, some of whom appear to be gesturing and looking towards the elevated central figure. The lines are fluid and sketch-like, creating a sense of motion and life within the scene. The background is filled with swirling clouds and cherub-like figures. The overall style shows intricate line work suggesting a narrative of religious or mythological significance.

artworks.title: A Noble Lady of Pisa
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, with incising throughout, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with a slight turn to her right. Her left hand rests on her hip while her right hand holds a feathered fan. Her profile features a slightly prominent nose and closed lips. Her hair is styled elaborately, pulled back and adorned with curls. She wears an ornate gown with intricate patterns, including a detailed bodice and flowing skirt. The gown is richly decorated and layered. She wears a necklace and earrings that complement her attire. The background is a plain surface with handwritten text in a calligraphic style using Latin script.

artworks.title: A Farmyard
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a low horizon. There is a rural building, potentially a barn or stable, on the right with a figure on a wooden balcony. To the left, there is a bare tree surrounded by logs and shrubs. The painting depicts fine, detailed brushstrokes capturing textured surfaces. The color palette consists of shades of gray, brown, and beige, creating a subdued effect. Two figures are seated on a log engaged in conversation in the foreground.

artworks.title: Washerwomen on the Beach at Etretat
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on blue paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group gathering near a rocky shoreline under a clear sky. In the foreground, several figures are depicted as sitting or kneeling on the pale sandy shore, engaging in a communal activity. The figures wear simple attire with muted colors, contrasting against a bright red accent seen on one of the individuals. In the background, a tall cliff overlooks the sea. The painting's treatment suggests a tranquil scene by the ocean.

artworks.title: Stellio Changed into a Lizard by Ceres
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with gray wash and white heightening
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a dimly lit outdoor setting at night. On the left, an older figure is seated, cloaked in a heavy garment with a hood. On the right, a figure stands upright, pouring water from a jug and holding a torch. They have long hair, flowing robes, and bare feet. Nearby is a small dog and an overturned wheel. The background features a night sky with a moon, trees, and a building.

artworks.title: Title Page for a Bible
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and blue wash over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural composition featuring Corinthian columns, friezes, a bearded figure holding a scroll, two figures under archways, a celestial scene on a globe with zodiac signs, hovering figures, and robed figures engaged in discussion or teaching.

artworks.title: Lady Picking Flowers
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile view, bending forward in a long flowing garment. They have long hair covered by a cap. The individual is focused on touching plants in front of them with their right hand. Their left arm is resting on their knee. The background features a pattern of symbols or letters.

artworks.title: Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene featuring figures surrounded by clouds and a heavenly atmosphere. The drawing is in a sketch-like manner, using delicate lines to depict human forms and clouds. At the top center, a dove encircled by radiant lines emanates light, positioned above the figures. The figures, seemingly divine beings, wear flowing robes and have graceful postures. They are surrounded by cherubic figures. The composition is balanced, with celestial forms within swirling clouds, creating a sense of movement and harmony. The drawing uses sparse shading to accentuate the lightness and spirituality of the scene.

artworks.title: Psyche Received on Mount Olympus
artworks.medium: brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures arranged on a cloud-like form. The figures are depicted in various poses, with some seated, others standing, and one reaching out as if handing or receiving something. The use of soft lines and shading creates movement and vitality within the composition. The background is filled with light sketches for depth and contrast with the figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Galley under Construction
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a large wooden ship under construction. The skeleton of the ship is being built on a structure of supporting posts. Detailed line work illustrates the ship's ribs and framework, and various figures are depicted around the ship, some working and others observing the progress. The drawing uses a monochromatic color scheme with shades of brown and sepia.

artworks.title: Homer and Calliope
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown and gray wash and white andpink heightening, squared in graphite, on brown p aper
artworks.description: In the image, there are two central figures. One is an older man seated, shown from the chest up with one hand resting on a rolled scroll. He has a beard and disheveled hair, and his expression is focused as he gazes upward. The man's body is muscular and mostly uncovered, with a cloth draped over his lap. An elegant woman stands beside him, gesturing towards him, with styled hair and flowing garments. The background features architectural elements like columns and arches.

artworks.title: Masinissa and Sophonisba
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a classical style setting. On the left, a man with medium-length hair stands with his back to the viewer, slightly turned towards the center of the image; he is dressed in a loosely draped garment and holds an object in one hand. On the right side, a seated man with a crown points at the standing man. The seated man is wearing an intricate garment. In the background, another figure is partially visible behind drapery, observing the interaction. The background features classical architecture with columns and arches, along with foliage on the left side.

artworks.title: Prince Charming in the Forest
artworks.medium: pen and brush and red ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person with a bow and arrow in a dense forest setting. The drawing depicts a figure dressed in a tunic and cap, poised to release an arrow from a bow. The scene is set in a lush forest, with tall trees surrounding the figure. The trees have thick trunks with closely spaced vertical lines representing bark, and leafy branches arched overhead. The composition features flowing vines and flowers that frame the figure. Intricate detailing on the foliage and the figure's attire enhances the drawing's liveliness and organic feel.

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and red chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly elevated view of a reclining male figure in the lower left, surrounded by scattered arrows. In the background, there are hills with vegetation. A figure is depicted above the man, encircled in a cloud formation. The painting uses fluid brushstrokes with sepia tones dominating the palette. A dog is seen to the right of the man, alongside lightly drawn trees and open space extending towards the hills.

artworks.title: Scene from the Inferno (canto IX)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows ethereal and earthly figures in a dynamic scene. Two winged, celestial beings interact with human figures in a turbulent sea. Additional figures are struggling, possibly within waves. One figure observes from the right. The illustration uses flowing lines and stark contrasts to convey movement and emotion, suggesting themes of struggle, observation, and the celestial versus mortal realms.

artworks.title: An Artist's Studio [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist in a studio surrounded by artworks. The image depicts a spacious studio with various pieces of art hanging on the walls and scattered on the floor. The wall is filled with drawings and paintings showing scenes and figures. An artist is seated at an easel, painting or drawing a canvas while holding a palette. The setting includes large windows bringing light into the space, and a nearby table holds sketches and rolled-up papers. A dog stands nearby.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with Classical Temple
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated point of view. It shows details both close to the viewer and in the distance. The horizon is vaguely suggested by distant mountains and clouds. On the right, mountain peaks and a waterfall are visible. In the foreground, there is a classical structure with columns partially hidden by tall trees. The brushstrokes are bold and textured, indicating depth. The color scheme is primarily brown, giving an antique look. The background sky is sparse with wispy clouds.

artworks.title: View of Scheveningen [recto]
artworks.medium: gray wash over black chalk on buff paper//border in pen and black ink added by later hand
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon featuring buildings, one of which has a high spire. In the foreground, there are rough pencil marks resembling loose terrain. The sketch is done in pencil with light brushstrokes, creating a monochromatic color palette. The background presents a simple sky, allowing the buildings and foreground to stand out.

artworks.title: Rustic House with a Well
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the composition, separating the sky and the land. The drawing features sketchy brushstrokes, creating a soft and unfinished appearance. The color scheme consists of pencil gray tones, establishing a gentle atmosphere. In the foreground, there are rustic structures, surrounded by trees with detailed foliage. A figure near a body of water is holding a fishing pole. The landscape extends into the distance, with faint hints of buildings on the horizon. Wispy clouds decorate the sky, contributing to the serene ambiance.

artworks.title: Five Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures standing together. The central figure is holding a bow and arrows, dressed in armor with a detailed breastplate and a short skirt. The figure has short hair and a crested helmet with feathers. Around them are other individuals with distinct clothing, such as an elderly man with a beard and a hooded cloak holding beads, and another person holding a staff with a child on their shoulder. The group is accompanied by a lion at their feet and two flying cherubs overhead. The background is a simple, light-toned wash.

artworks.title: Religious Procession in Landeck
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink, graphite and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession with various banners and figures. The image depicts a long horizontal arrangement of figures who are part of a procession or ceremonial gathering. Several banners are held high, with their fabric waving. The figures are loosely sketched, with minimal detail, yet distinct enough to convey their participation in a communal activity. The background remains lightly detailed, focusing the attention on the group of individuals and the banners they carry. The sparse use of color adds a subtle warmth to the otherwise monochromatic sketch.
